profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer @ Capital One
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer based out of Baltimore, Maryland. Strong professional engineering skills in Full Stack Development with a focus on Backend Distributed Systems using Agile Methodologies.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Olive was acquired by Waystar in Nov. 2023
-----------------------------------------

IAM Team
-----------------------------------------
• Implemented authN and authZ solutions adopted by 3 internal teams to secure healthcare data following Oauth 2.0 specifications using Typescript and Python as serverless Lambdas using a DynamoDB backend.
• Suite of products were written with Typescript, Python, DyanmoDB, Amazon API Gateway, and more, all hosted on AWS Lambdas via Gitlab CI/CD pipelines.

Monetization Team
-----------------------------------------
• Responsible for full stack implementation to drive monetization on the Olive Helps platform by integrating with Stripe for payments.
• Architected and developed subscription APIs in Node that brought in monetary traffic into our application.
• Integrated Node API into our React frontend all hosted on AWS ECS via Gitlab CI/CD pipelines.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
ByteLion was acquired by Olive in 2021
-----------------------------------------
Kroger Contract

Lead Software Engineer: Kroger Contract
-----------------------------------------
• Lead a team of 3 (2 software engineers and 1 QA engineer) on a contract with Kroger for managing warehouse data.
• Architected and developed a Java (Spring) application, deployed out to Azure, to run ETL processes for identifying item locations within a warehouse & grocery store.
• With the success of ByteLion’s services to deliver high quality products to over 20 clients, ByteLion was acquired by Olive.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Digital University

Full Stack Engineer: Digital University
--------------------------------------
• Senior software engineer for BESPIN's Digital University that supported over 20,000 users. (https://digitalu.af.mil/)
• Built a learning management platform for Airmen to enable technology education for greater opportunities. Platform was written in Next.js, Express, Firebase on GCP.
• Mentored airmen by collaborative working sessions.

positions.title: Java Engineer
positions.description:
• Search/Match Engineer
• Back-End Java developer
• Enhanced recruiters’ search experiences, allowing recruiters’ to spend less time searching and more time building relationships with talents around the world.
• In a large development team, built search as well as match functionalities to our Applicant Tracking System.
• Constant interaction with the front-end team for smooth and successful integrations.
• Use of Elasticsearch as our search platform
• Test Driven Development using the JUnit testing framework.
• Agile Scrum environment
• Data analysis, parsing, and curation
• ETL Processes

positions.title: Product Team Intern
positions.description:
• Identifying defects and suggestions for the application in development.
• QA testing
• Automation script testing
• JavaScript development
• Experienced an Agile Scrum project environment
